content:
Apple TV's hotly anticipated fourth season of "Ted Lasso" has kicked off with a bang, but three more high-profile new titles are on the way.

Number one: 'Dark Matter'

Apple TV has plenty of great sci-fi shows on its roster. Beyond the well-known titles like 'Severance' and 'Pluribus,' there's one series beloved by fans that you may have missed: 'Dark Matter.'

The series is adapted from the best-selling novel by Blake Crouch and stars Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly.

Season 2 of 'Dark Matter' will premiere its first episode on Friday, August 28, with new episodes dropping weekly until October 30.

Here's Apple's synopsis for the show:

Number two: 'Mayday'

Apple TV's fall lineup is packed, with most titles heading straight to streaming rather than debuting in theaters first.

Kicking things off is 'Mayday,' an action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh — a playful spin on the classic spy thriller.

'Mayday' will debut exclusively on Apple TV on Friday, September 4.

Here's Apple's synopsis and trailer for the film:

Number three: 'Slow Horses'

One of Apple's most acclaimed series, 'Slow Horses,' is set to return.

In the streaming era, viewers often have to wait years for a new season of their favorite shows. But 'Slow Horses' has kept up a yearly cadence, continuing to deliver gripping spy stories led by Gary Oldman as Jackson Lamb and his team.

Season 6 of 'Slow Horses' will premiere its first episode on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes dropping weekly until October 21.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or it can be bundled through the Apple One subscription package.
